print_errors.note: Printed «على» with undotted alef maqsura (regular weight); the name is presumably «علي بركة التطواني». Kept as printed. Bold begins at «بركة» and runs through «وشرحه هذا مخطوط،».
«الاخوان» printed without hamza under the alif (cf. «اجازة» on p.012); kept as printed.

notes: p013, p014, p015 and p016 each continue the previous page's sentence, so all four markers have '+'. No footnotes on any page. p014: the opening bayt of Ibn Malik's riddle verse is printed side by side in a heavier font with no harakat. It is written as a :::شعر block without ** because the whole block is set in that font. The spaced en-dashes on p014 («سكيرج – وهو …مؤلفات – برسالة», «فلان – يعنيني –») are written as U+2013 with spaces, as printed. Every «رضي الله عنه» / «رحمه الله» in this batch is printed as ordinary words, not as glyphs. Final ى in Lotus Light is written without the automatic small alif (على، أخرى، الفتاوى، حكى، أتى، أجزنَّاى). The year ١٣٤٩ is in Arabic-Indic digits.
